info.name: Tègbalé API
info.description:
Complete API test suite for the Tègbalé School Management Platform.

**Setup:**
1. `baseUrl` is already set to `https://staging-api.tegbale.com`
2. Run **Login** — the test script auto-saves the token to `{{token}}` and `{{refreshToken}}`
3. All authenticated requests use `Bearer {{token}}` automatically
4. After creating resources, copy returned IDs into the collection variables

**Roles:** SUPER_ADMIN · SCHOOL_ADMIN · STAFF · TEACHER · PARENT

**Typical happy-path flow:**
1. Health Check → Login → Get Me
2. Create School → Create Staff → Create Classroom
3. Create Student → Assign to Classroom
4. Create Parent → Assign Ward
5. Create Event → Create Post → Send Message
